subject: Render ready for review 2: v2 sidecar+submit hook, mips/3D/array/cube/MS facts, target compile PASS
body:
Second checkpoint ready. No commit/phone/build. Changed production files: render_encoder.inc, render_pipeline.inc, device_limits.h, compositor_submit.inc (root grant).

IMPLEMENTED
- tegu_generic_v2_build_job builds n2r_texture_binding[] from the draw request/retained TeguTexture/TeguSampler: full backing span, per-level relative offsets/row_stride, 3D depth/slice, array/cube/MS layers/samples/array_length/layer_stride, access=SAMPLE, usage/storage_mode. Exact runtime sampler state via tegu_sampler_get_state. Immutable v2 refuses explicitly (Vulkan enums/missing Metal state), legacy level1 unchanged.
- compositor_submit.inc: v2-required draws call additive n2mb_draw_v2(...,&n2r_texture_resources,...) with a sidecar rebuilt/validated at submit; old n2mb_draw unchanged for the rest. Symbol declared weak (weak_import Apple) so current tree links; missing bridge symbol is an explicit command error, never level0. Exact non-applied bridge patch at workers/render/proposed_n2mb_draw_v2.patch.
- allocation/facts: usage=1 2D mip chains with 64-byte rows; R55 3D depth/slice; usage=1/options=0 2D-array, cube, cube-array, 2D-MS, 2D-MS-array, bounded to <=256 subresources, layer-major levels. Existing usage5/private layouts unchanged. CPU copies remain layer0/slice0 only.
- STAGE/INDEX/lifetime/neutral/VertexIndex behavior from checkpoint1 preserved.

TESTS (actual)
- python3 build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py -> PASS. Includes direct n2r_build_v2 on a 2-level BGRA8 + linear sampler (descriptor level=1/array=0), 3D depth2 8192B, 2D-array layers2 2048B, cube layers6 6144B, 4xMSAA 4096B, immutable-v2 refusal, and the actual tegu_generic_draw_submit v2 branch with a strong stub for the weak bridge symbol (sidecar levels=2, successful reply). Real magma, same-slot, VertexIndex, indexed pulling, lifetime tests pass.
- ARM64 production frontend clang -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only -> no diagnostics (current compute tree).
- tests/iosurface_cpu_test.py PASS.
- Existing frontend_jm_test currently links stale research/nord2-host-air Rust lib and fails on tegu_air_pipeline_native_dispatch_v2; that is an integration lib-pointer issue, not a render source failure. Root must rebuild/point it.

REMAINING GAPS
- compute n2mb_draw_v2 (patch provided) is the only transport piece.
- compute air_bridge generic planner still refuses mips>1/array/MS and lacks exact view_format/per-use compare + plan.specialization sidecar; lowering specialization API exists but render has no bytes.
- immutable v2 exact Metal fields missing; normal sampler factory still narrow (textures).
- first/base-vertex additive request fields not frozen; explicit command error remains.
- VkFormat83 owned by lowering/compute/textures; not edited.
No hardware qualification claimed.
